record.title: LADDER: Language-Driven Slice Discovery and Error Rectification in Vision Classifiers
record.reason: LADDER is a general vision-classifier bias-discovery and mitigation method with substantial but parallel medical experiments. Physical pages 5–8 explicitly evaluate three natural-image datasets (Waterbirds, CelebA, MetaShift) and three medical datasets (NIH CXR, RSNA-Mammo, VinDr-Mammo), with common RQs and additional UrbanCars/ImageNet experiments. The medical arm includes pneumothorax/chest-tube and mammographic calcification biases, report-based retrieval, and a dedicated DICOM/age-metadata analysis. Those are substantive medical substudies, but the overall actual study remains mixed-domain general slice discovery rather than biomedical-primary. Boundary evidence sent to central for independent review.
